title: 全球AI巨头50强：美国占43席，欧洲急了？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: This is a story about keeping up with the Joneses.
segments.zh: 这是一个关于追赶潮流的故事。

segments.en: The United States has led the world in building huge technology companies and attracting enormous capital.
segments.zh: 美国在打造大型科技公司和吸引巨额资本方面一直领先世界。

segments.en: Now, it's riding the crest of that wave into the revolution that is artificial intelligence, while Europe looks on with envy,
segments.zh: 如今，它正乘着这股浪潮进入人工智能革命，而欧洲只能羡慕地旁观。

segments.en: or at least with a strong desire to try to catch up.
segments.zh: 或者说，至少怀有强烈的追赶愿望。

segments.en: Now, at the highest levels, it's trying to do something about it.
segments.zh: 现在，欧洲高层正试图采取行动。

segments.en: Growth has been slowing down for a long time in Europe.
segments.zh: 欧洲的经济增长长期以来一直在放缓。

segments.en: But we've ignored it. Now, we cannot ignore it any longer.
segments.zh: 但我们一直忽视这一点。现在，我们不能再忽视了。

segments.en: Now, conditions have changed. We need new tech champions in Europe.
segments.zh: 现在，情况已经改变。欧洲需要新的科技领军者。

segments.en: The fact of the matter is 43, the largest 50 companies in AI are US-based.
segments.zh: 事实上，全球最大的50家AI公司中，有43家总部在美国。

segments.en: Europe has won. The quest for Europe to get into the mega-tech game is one of the reasons it's now undertaking the biggest revision to its merger rules
segments.zh: 欧洲已经落后。为了进入大型科技赛道，欧洲正在对其并购规则进行最大规模的修订。

segments.en: in over 20 years. And few people know more about the potential impacts for businesses and consumers than Fiona Scott Morton,
segments.zh: 超过20年。很少有人比Fiona Scott Morton更了解这对企业和消费者的潜在影响。

segments.en: a professor at the Yale School of Management, and a former chief economist at the Antitrust Division of the US Department of Justice.
segments.zh: 她是耶鲁管理学院教授，曾任美国司法部反垄断部门首席经济学家。

segments.en: There's been a lot of angst in Europe over growth and the ability of Europe to stay at the technological frontier.
segments.zh: 欧洲对增长以及能否保持技术前沿地位存在很多担忧。

segments.en: And we've had a couple of reports, the letter report, and most recently, the Draghi report that have really hammered on that
segments.zh: 我们看到了几份报告，比如莱特报告，以及最近的德拉吉报告，都强调了这一点。

segments.en: and pointed out all the issues in Europe that are holding back Europe from more growth.
segments.zh: 并指出了欧洲在增长方面面临的各种问题。
